segments.ja494:3.5: Saramānā hi te devā, sudhammāyaṃ samacchare.
segments.ja494:4.1: Tato ca rājā sādhino [sādhīno (sī. pī.)], vedeho mithilaggaho [pamukho rathamāruhi (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja494:5.1: Svāgataṃ te mahārāja, atho te adurāgataṃ;
segments.ja494:5.3: Nisīda dāni rājīsi [rājisi (sī. syā. pī.)], devarājassa santike.
segments.ja494:6.3: Nimantayittha [nimantayī ca (sī. pī.)] kāmehi, āsanena ca vāsavo.
segments.ja494:8.1: Ahaṃ pure saggagato ramāmi, naccehi gītehi ca vāditehi;
segments.ja494:8.3: So dāni ajja na ramāmi sagge, āyuṃ nu khīṇo [khīṇaṃ (syā.)] maraṇaṃ nu santike;
segments.ja494:9.1: Na tāyu [na cāyu (sī. pī. ka.)] khīṇaṃ maraṇañca [maraṇaṃ te (sī. pī.)] dūre, na cāpi mūḷho naravīraseṭṭha;
segments.ja494:9.3: Tuyhañca [tavañca (sī. pī.), tava ca (ka.)] puññāni parittakāni, yesaṃ vipākaṃ idha vedayittho [vedayato (pī. ka.)].
segments.ja494:11.1: Yathā yācitakaṃ yānaṃ, yathā yācitakaṃ dhanaṃ;
segments.ja494:12.3: Sayaṃkatāni puññāni, taṃ me āveṇikaṃ [āveṇiyaṃ (sī. syā. pī.), āvenikaṃ (ka.)] dhanaṃ.
segments.ja494:13.1: Sohaṃ gantvā manussesu, kāhāmi kusalaṃ bahuṃ;
segments.ja494:13.5: Yaṃ katvā sukhito hoti, na ca pacchānutappati.
segments.ja494:14.1: Imāni tāni khettāni, imaṃ nikkhaṃ sukuṇḍalaṃ;
segments.ja494:14.3: Imā tā haritānūpā, imā najjo savantiyo.
segments.ja494:15.1: Imā tā pokkharaṇī rammā, cakkavākapakūjitā [cakkavākūpakūjitā (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja494:15.5: Yassimāni mamāyiṃsu, kiṃ nu te disataṃ gatā.
segments.ja494:16.1: Tānīdha khettāni so bhūmibhāgo, teyeva ārāmavanupacārā [te ārāmā te vana’ me pacārā (sī. pī.), te yeva ārāmavanāni sañcarā (ka.)];
segments.ja494:16.3: Tameva mayhaṃ janataṃ apassato, suññaṃva me nārada khāyate disā.
segments.ja494:18.1: Vutthaṃ me bhavanaṃ dibyaṃ [dibbaṃ (sī. pī.)], bhuttā kāmā amānusā;
segments.ja494:20.3: Taṃ maggaṃ paṭipajjissaṃ, yena gacchanti subbatāti.
